svg.aria-label: The disclosure mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Intake: the venue or the policy anchor, the policy of a venue not listed, the kinds of AI use the records leave uncertain; you confirm (stop); Draft writer: the statements (agent); Draft writer once more: the model identifier, when the model list gave none or the served one differs (agent, only when needed).
